column1: # Consolidate cache key/admission policy into the live cache owner.

column9: The isolated key and admission policy is now internal state of the single bounded owner exposed at the request-preparation and response-handling seam; TiKV transport invocation remains unimplemented and explicit in the source evidence.
The byte-exact key vectors now execute beside the cache consumer that uses those keys.
Request and response admission now directly gate cache preparation and population.
The cost calculation now bounds the live deterministic store and preserves page-range presence.
The finite negative-capacity regression remains exact in the consolidated constructor.
